title: AIR DATA SYSTEM - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What are the key safety and system verification procedures to follow after reinstalling the GDC-74 Air Data Unit?
answer: Remove the GDC-74 Air Data Unit . (1) Make sure the MASTER and AVIONICS switches are in the off position. (2) Remove the MFD. Refer to Chapter 34, Control Display Unit - Maintenance Practices. (3)  Loosen the screws that hold the air data unit in position. (4)  Move the air data unit aft to get access to the hose and the electrical connector . (5) Disconnect the hose and the electrical connector from the air data unit.Install the GDC-74 Air Data Unit . (1) Connect the hose and the electrical connector  to the air data unit. (2) Move the air data unit forward into position. Tighten the screws that hold the air data unit in position. Install the MFD. Refer to Chapter 34, Control Display Unit - Maintenance Practices. (5) Do a pitot and static system leakage rate test after installation of the air data unit. Refer to Chapter 34, Pitot and Static Systems - Maintenance Practices. Do a check to make sure the air data unit operates correctly. Refer to the Garmin G1000 Line

answer: Remove the GDC-74 Air Data Unit . (1) Make sure the MASTER and AVIONICS switches are in the off position. (2) Remove the MFD. Refer to Chapter 34, Control Display Unit - Maintenance Practices. (3)  Loosen the screws that hold the air data unit in position. (4)  Move the air data unit aft to get access to the hose and the electrical connector . (5) Disconnect the hose and the electrical connector from the air data unit.Install the GDC-74 Air Data Unit . (1) Connect the hose and the electrical connector  to the air data unit. (2) Move the air data unit forward into position. Tighten the screws that hold the air data unit in position. Install the MFD. Refer to Chapter 34, Control Display Unit - Maintenance Practices. (5) Do a pitot and static system leakage rate test after installation of the air data unit. Refer to Chapter 34, Pitot and Static Systems - Maintenance Practices. Do a check to make sure the air data unit operates correctly. Refer to the Garmin G1000 Line

title: AIR DATA SYSTEM - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: How does the placement of the GDC-74 Air Data Unit relative to the Multi-Function Display influence its ability to perform air data measurements?
answer: The Air Data System maintenance practices give procedures for the air data unit removal/installation.The GDC-74 Air Data Unit calculates pitot, static, and outside air temperature functions. The air data unit is an interface of these functions within the integrated avionics systems. The air data unit is forward of the Multi-Function Display .
